---
title: "Studio guide"
---

The mascot studio (`mascot_studio()`) explains every function on a page of its own: what it does, what to try, and
the common mistakes. The same pages are here, grouped the way the studio groups them.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
studio <- system.file("examples", "studio", package = "mascot")
# The studio's own grouping (plain data): the groups, and the group of each function.
groups <- new.env()
sys.source(file.path(studio, "R", "guide.R"), envir = groups)
pages <- sub("[.]Rmd$", "", list.files(file.path(studio, "guide"), pattern = "^[^_].*[.]Rmd$"))

# One line per function: the title of its help page.
help_titles <- function() {
  titles <- character()
  for (rd in tools::Rd_db("mascot")) {
    tag <- function(tag) Filter(function(el) identical(attr(el, "Rd_tag"), tag), rd)
    title <- trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", paste(unlist(tag("\\title")), collapse = "")))
    aliases <- unlist(tag("\\alias"))
    titles[aliases] <- title
  }
  titles
}
titles <- help_titles()
```

```{r groups, echo = FALSE}
category <- vapply(groups$studio_guide, `[[`, character(1), "category")
sections <- lapply(names(groups$studio_categories), function(id) {
  group <- groups$studio_categories[[id]]
  fns <- intersect(names(category)[category == id], pages)
  if (length(fns) == 0L) {
    return(character())
  }
  c(
    paste("##", group$title),
    "",
    group$summary,
    "",
    sprintf("- [`%s()`](guide-%s.html): %s", fns, fns, titles[fns]),
    ""
  )
})
knitr::asis_output(paste(unlist(sections), collapse = "\n"))
```
